title: Cheese Dreams
description: Crispy, cheesy two-bite sandwich snacks made with sharp cheddar, butter, and a savory spread, perfect as an appetizer.

steps.instruction: Preheat the oven to 375°F and line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
Trim the crusts off the bread and cut each slice into 4 equal squares.
In a medium bowl, beat the cheddar cheese and softened butter with a hand mixer until well combined.
Add the egg and beat until fully incorporated.
Add the heavy cream, Worcestershire sauce, garlic powder, mustard powder, salt, and hot sauce if using, then beat until smooth.
Spread about 1 teaspoon of the cheese mixture onto one side of a bread square.
Top with another bread square to form a sandwich.
Spread more cheese mixture over the top and sides of the sandwich, leaving the bottom plain.
Repeat with the remaining bread and cheese mixture, placing the sandwiches about 1 inch apart on the baking sheet.
Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown and crisp.
Serve immediately with marinara sauce for dipping if desired.
